intro: This quest represents the hard-earned recognition of a seasoned artisan following the defeat of Onyxia. Major Mattingly imparts the vital technique required to craft an Onyxia Scale Cloak, turning the fallen broodmother's remains into essential protection against her brother.

clips.title: Completion
paras: A dragon slayer and a seasoned leatherworker? You do not cease to astonish, hero. I am humbled.
Please accept what I am about to teach you. This knowledge will prove to be invaluable if you are to destroy what remains of the Black Dragonflight.
Create the cloak from the scales of the brood mother. It will protect you and your allies against the incendiary breath of the Lord of Blackrock... Nefarian.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
